jobs.title: Audio Engineer
jobs.description:
At Crooked, we believe the answer to a rising authoritarian movement is a democratic movement powerful enough to fight it and (fingers crossed) defeat it. That means using all the tools at our disposal as a media company to help build a massive, diverse coalition united behind a core set of democratic values: freedom, equality, compassion, and the rule of law.



Crooked believes that we need a better conversation about politics, culture, and the world around us—one that doesn't just focus on what's broken, but what we can do to fix it. We are a media network that showcases stories, voices, and opportunities for activism that inform, entertain, and inspire action, because it's up to all of us to do our part to build a better world.


**Job Summary:**



Crooked is hiring for an **Audio Engineer** on the **Audio** department reporting to the **Associate Director, Production**. This role will focus on recording, assembling, and mixing our podcasts. The ideal candidate is a team player and enjoys a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment, where you are often jumping from task to task. Interest in comedy and helping people understand the news is also a plus!


*This role is based on\-site (Mon\-Fri) in our Los Angeles office, with a schedule that requires a mix of days running from 9am\-5:30pm or 12pm\-8:30pm, and may be asked to travel from time to time. We are ideally looking for Los Angeles based candidates, or candidates willing to relocate before the start date.*


**How You'll Spend Your Time****:**


* Setting up and testing sound equipment before each recording
* Running recording sessions (both remote and in studio)
* Mixing sessions to proper loudness specs, sourcing and placing music on deadline
* Resolving technical issues when they arise
* Editing, mixing and sound designing other audio (promos, ads, etc.) as assigned
* Collaborating with producers, videographers, and other team members


This job description provides a summary of how you'll spend your time but is nowhere near exhaustive, so other duties may be assigned over time.


**What You'll Bring To The Table****:**


* 3\+ years experience with sound editing and recording equipment
* Technical expertise in sound engineering techniques in studio and live sound environments
* Expertise in ProTools and a working knowledge of other audio software and hardware like iZotope RX suite, Totalmix, RME products
* Expertise in recording using Zoom and Riverside
* Understanding of field recording gear such as Shure MV7, Zoom H4N and Zoom Podtrack P4
* Experience mixing live sound. Experience mixing variety or comedy shows a plus.
* Experience setting up and tearing down sound stage audio and recording equipment in live audience environments is a plus
* Experience mixing variety shows for live audience and podcast recording simultaneously is a plus
* Creativity in both the style of your mixing and in solving production problems
* A team player with excellent communication skills
* A self\-motivated, proactive, and nice attitude
* Punctual, accountable, and easily reachable during work hours
* Ability to lift 40 lbs


**Pay and Perks:**



This position is covered under the Writers Guild of America East Collective Bargaining Agreement and the salary for this role is **$90,000\.**  

  

In addition to your salary, we also offer full\-time employees excellent benefits, including:


* Paid healthcare
* 401k match
* Generous vacation and paid leave including, sick, bereavement, pregnancy loss, and disability leaves
* 20 weeks of paid parental leave
* Commuter reimbursement or paid parking
* Communications stipend
* Professional development opportunities
* Did we also mention our offices are closed at the end of the year?

**About Us**



We welcome everyone—as an inclusive workplace, we invite all our employees to bring their authentic, whole selves to work. Our mission and intent is to encourage people from every nation, race/ethnicity, belief, gender, gender identity, sexual identity, disability, and culture to feel respected and valued for their unique contributions to our company.



We approach our work courageously, adapt and improve constantly, and celebrate the wins big and small. We cultivate a culture of creativity and expression at Crooked Media. We hire the best talent, ensure they have the tools and training they need, and set them free. If you have a high degree of ownership and are driven to excel, you'll fit right in.



That's it. End of mission.

jobs.title: Sound Design Instructor - San Diego
jobs.description:
**Why join our team**

At Options For All, we create opportunities for adults with disabilities to live, work, and love life in their community with dignity and respect. As a USA TODAY Top Workplace, we are proud to build a culture where team members feel supported, valued, and connected to meaningful work.


As an Sound Design Instructor, you will make a difference every day by helping people build independence, make choices, and work toward their goals. This is more than a job. It is a chance to create real impact while joining a mission\-driven organization that values dignity, inclusion, and respect. We are looking for people who care deeply, take initiative, and want to help others thrive.


**Why you’ll love it here**

At Options For All, we believe a great workplace starts with putting people first. We are proud to build a culture where team members feel supported, valued, and connected to the work they do. We celebrate diversity, foster belonging, and create opportunities for growth.


**When you join our team, you can expect:**

* A supportive team environment
* Meaningful work that makes a difference
* An inclusive culture where you belong
* Opportunities to learn and grow

**Your benefits start on Day 1:**

* 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees
* Comprehensive coverage for qualifying dependents, including 100% dental and vision and 50% medical
* Retirement savings plan with up to a 5% company match
* Mileage reimbursement for work\-related travel
* Paid vacation, sick time, and paid holidays, including your birthday
* Student Loan Repayment Assistance Program

**What you’ll be doing**

As the Sound Design Instructor, you create and deliver hands\-on curriculum that teaches clients the fundamentals of sound design, audio recording, podcast production, music production, sound effects creation, film scoring, editing, and mixing for film and digital media projects. Through collaborative and project\-based learning, clients develop technical skills, creative problem\-solving abilities, communication skills, and confidence while gaining experience with industry\-standard tools and workflows. The instructor fosters an inclusive learning environment that empowers clients to tell stories through sound and prepares them for opportunities in media production and related career pathways.


**In this role, you will:**

* Teach sound design, audio recording, podcast production, music production, sound effects creation, film scoring, audio editing, and mixing through hands\-on, industry\-informed instruction.
* Create engaging lesson plans and learning activities that help students develop technical audio skills, creative expression, storytelling abilities, and career readiness.
* Support students with individualized coaching, constructive feedback, and encouragement tailored to their strengths, goals, and learning styles.
* Guide students through the audio production process for studio projects, including recording, sound design, dialogue editing, music production, mixing, mastering, and final audio deliverables.
* Help students apply sound and music to film, digital media, podcasts, and other creative productions while fostering collaboration across production teams.
* Partner with team members to support student progress, vocational development, employment opportunities, and successful participation in studio and community\-based experiences.
* Maintain a safe, organized, and supportive learning environment that encourages creativity, confidence, communication, and teamwork.
* Support program documentation, audio equipment oversight, studio organization, and other responsibilities that help the program operate effectively and provide high\-quality learning experiences.

**What we’re looking for**

We are looking for someone who is compassionate, dependable, and ready to make a positive impact.


**Education**

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* Bachelors degree preferred

**Experience**

* Three or more years of experience in screenwriting, filmmaking, acting instruction, theater arts, or media production.
* Experience teaching or coaching acting, storytelling, scriptwriting, or film production in a classroom, workshop, or community\-based setting
* Experience teaching, coaching, or supporting others in building new skills.
* Strong organizational, communication, and time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, stay organized, and meet deadlines.
* Comfort using Microsoft Office and other basic workplace technology.

**Preferred**

* Experience developing original screenplays, short films, or creative media projects from concept through production.
* Knowledge of character development, scene construction, dialogue writing, and cinematic storytelling techniques.
* Experience with budgeting, location scouting, script supervising, assistant directing, or other production leadership responsibilities.
* A portfolio, demo reel, or other samples of relevant film and media work.

**Other Requirements**

* 21 years of age or older
* A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and an acceptable driving record are required for this role.
* This role requires travel within the region where services are provided.
* Final candidates must successfully complete a background check.

**Physical Demands \& Work Environment**

This position requires the employee to regularly stand, walk, sit, talk and hear. The employee must be capable of writing, using a computer keyboard, telephone and related office equipment. Ability to lift 10lbs. required.
  

  

The physical demands are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  

  

The employee will experience normal office conditions with a well\-lighted work area and minor noise from standard office equipm
